description:
## [1.7.0](https://github.com/ihatenodejs/aidans-patches/compare/v1.6.0...v1.7.0) (2026-10-13)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **geocaching:** neutralized server sync for experimental features ([ab635cb](https://github.com/ihatenodejs/aidans-patches/commit/ab635cb6170d5ba5fb1e821f4f5e2c9c4e59c7b2))
* **release:** update bun lockfile for semantic-release github plugin ([cea934f](https://github.com/ihatenodejs/aidans-patches/commit/cea934f8955192f773b46ea402fed80045e8c641))
* **site:** prevented linking prior workflow run url on queued badges ([97c50a9](https://github.com/ihatenodejs/aidans-patches/commit/97c50a92aa8eb35ba0039d3487246db23893c3c1))

### ✨ New Features

* **geocaching:** added developer tools patch and experimental toggles ([e99ec24](https://github.com/ihatenodejs/aidans-patches/commit/e99ec24ffaf7b78e5b1adfc0e4e68d1fbbabd8c9))
* **geocaching:** added experimental map sheet support for osm styles ([1f29c32](https://github.com/ihatenodejs/aidans-patches/commit/1f29c327d9c847bc34cad0dbb7970b331d0375e5))
* **sidelineswap:** added remove invite friends patch ([04328a9](https://github.com/ihatenodejs/aidans-patches/commit/04328a924ddd04de690da61b7b3937adbb26d789))
* **site:** added ViewMoreAppsCard and Crosshair components ([b66cb3d](https://github.com/ihatenodejs/aidans-patches/commit/b66cb3d1d7746bc24ad4f5964d4cbbfc0cc5a4e2))

patches.name: Remove Ads and Tracking
patches.description: Disables Adobe, Branch, Facebook, Creative SDK, and Crashlytics telemetry; removes in-app ads and review prompts; blocks install-referrer collection; and zeroes the Google Play Advertising ID.

options.description: Removes the Send usage info and Send crash info preferences and suppresses the crash reports dialog, whose telemetry backends are disabled by this patch.

patches.name: Remove Login
patches.description: Starts Adobe Scan in its existing account-free local workspace and removes account sign-in gates; Adobe cloud features are unavailable.

options.description: Removes the profile icon and sign-out option from the Settings menu.
Removes cloud link sharing options from the Share sheet, preserving local PDF sharing.
Removes the non-functional Edit text option from file option menus and the preview screen.
Removes the non-functional Move file option from file option menus.
Removes the cloud-dependent Save as Word doc option from scan cards.

patches.name: Remove Useless/Promotional Items
patches.description: Removes promotional, feedback, and support items from Settings and file menus.

options.description: Removes the About Adobe Scan item from the Settings menu.
Removes the Help item from the Settings menu.
Removes the Rate app item from the Settings menu.
Removes the Online support forum item from the Settings menu.
Removes the Share this app item from the Settings menu.
Removes the Fill & Sign item from the File Options bottom sheet.
Removes the Open in Adobe Acrobat option from file option menus and the preview screen.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Enables locally executable premium OCR, editing, compression, and page-organization tools without cloud or GenAI access.

options.description: Removes broken cloud-dependent actions like Generative summary.
Enables Combine, Export, and Protect PDF for signed-in accounts with compatible Adobe Document Cloud access.

patches.name: Use System Font
patches.description: Overrides Adobe Clean fonts across XML layouts, dialogs, and Jetpack Compose screens with the device's system font.

patches.name: Add Copy Tracking Number Option
patches.description: Adds an option to copy tracking numbers in the multi-shipment selection menu.

patches.name: Bypass Native Signature Check
patches.description: Neutralizes APK signature verification in libandroidsig-lib.so so API requests succeed when signed with custom keys.

patches.name: Custom Google Maps API Key
patches.description: Replaces the embedded Google Maps API key with a personal Google Cloud API key so native Google Maps renders on re-signed builds. Note: To use native Google Maps, disable the OpenStreetMap Drop-in Replacement patch.

options.description: Custom Google Maps API key from Google Cloud Console (with Maps SDK for Android enabled).

patches.name: Full AMOLED Theme
patches.description: Themes AfterShip in pure AMOLED black by removing dark gray backgrounds from the bottom navigation bar, account items, cards, and windows.

patches.name: Hide Broken Tracking Map
patches.description: Suppresses the unauthenticated blank white Google Maps view when neither a custom Google Maps API key nor OpenStreetMap is used.

patches.name: OpenStreetMap Drop-in Replacement
patches.description: Replaces the broken Google Maps view with a free, self-contained OpenStreetMap (Leaflet) engine that renders routes, checkpoints, and dark/light styled tiles without requiring an API key.

options.description: Displays floating + and − zoom buttons on the map.

patches.name: Remove Ads and Tracking
patches.description: Neutralizes in-app advertisements (Disco Network SDK shopping/cashback ads and list placements), removes the 'Leave us a 5-star review' in-app rating prompt dialogs, zeros the Google Play Advertising ID (AAID), disables first-party behavioral and impression analytics (StatisticsCenter, AbsListImpEventHelper, AutoUploadManager), and blocks diagnostic telemetry (Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Logan logging).

patches.name: Remove AfterShip Account Page Links
patches.description: Removes the About the app, Share the app, and Feedback links from the Account screen.

patches.name: Remove Feedback
patches.description: Removes prompting for feedback on shipments.

patches.name: Remove Login
patches.description: Forces guest mode always on first install, removes login buttons and carousels, strips account/login controls from the Account tab, and suppresses login prompts.

patches.name: Remove Shipment Sync
patches.description: Removes email shipment synchronization features, including prompts, banners, dialogs, empty state sync cards, and account settings.

patches.name: Enable Developer Settings
patches.description: Adds an in-app developer mod menu accessible via a top-bar header button, with controls for Mobile Studio.

options.description: Includes Mobile Studio trigger in the developer settings menu and permanently unlocks Mobile Studio access.

patches.name: Remove Ads
patches.description: Removes sponsored feed advertisements and optional marketplace listing advertisements from the feed.

options.description: Removes marketplace listing advertisements injected into the feed.

patches.name: Remove Tracking and Analytics
patches.description: Neutralizes first-party client event tracking, Mixpanel analytics, Airbridge and Adjust attribution SDKs, Google Advertising ID (AAID) collection, and bypasses PairIP Play Integrity verification, with options for silent DM screenshots and Sentry telemetry removal.

options.description: Suppresses screenshot notification dispatches to chat counterparts in direct message conversations.
Neutralizes Sentry crash reporting, performance tracing, and operational session telemetry.

patches.name: Replace Emoji Font with iOS
patches.description: Replaces Android system emoji with iOS Apple Color Emoji across Compose UI, posts, comments, and direct messages.

patches.name: Remove Tracking and Telemetry
patches.description: Neutralizes Gainsight PX behavioral analytics (session tracking, screen views, custom events, user identification) and disables the Cordova Gainsight native plugin.

patches.name: Remove Web Telemetry
patches.description: Removes Sentry error/performance reporting, CSP telemetry endpoints, and Gainsight web bootstrap scripts from the embedded Cordova web bundle.

patches.name: Enable Developer Tools and Feature Flags
patches.description: Exposes the internal Debug Menu in Settings and provides selectors for LaunchDarkly feature flags, Remote Config controls, and remaining membership gates.

options.description: Restores the internal Debug Menu item in Settings (LaunchDarkly overrides, Remote Config overrides, AutoLogger, Style/Component/Tooltip previews, and DebugSharedPrefs toggles).
Enables the internal Debug.TEST_AWARD tap handler in AchievementActivity to test confetti and cycle achievement states.
Unlocks Trails and Wheelchair Trails in MapTypeSelectionFragment when OpenStreetMap Drop-in Replacement is not enabled.
Unlocks newsletter language selection and hides the Basic-account upgrade banner in NewsletterSettingsFragment.
Enables Premium-only controls in HideCacheViewModel and ConversationViewModel GC code validation.
Enables the redesigned Geocache Details layout (cache-details-rework).
Shows the total log count in geocache activity and details (show-total-log-count).
Enables in-app Shareables, filter, and FTUE (show-shareables-in-app, mobile-shareables-filter, mobile-shareables-ftue).
Enables the collaborative lists feature in Listhub (collaborative-lists).
Enables Lodestone features across the app (show-lodestones-mobile).
Enables editing geocache log dates and date selector (edit-geocache-log, show-log-date-selector).
Enables Better Events filter, map, and AR attribute (better-events-filter, better-events-map, show-ar-attribute-in-filter).
Enables select cache types and filter settings saving (select-cache-types, save-filter-settings).
Enables diagnostic info, FCM token display, ANR data prompt, API regions, and map timeout.
Forces the map tray feature enabled (RemoteConfig.MAP_TRAY).
Forces hiding the last log DNF count (RemoteConfig.HIDE_LAST_LOG_DNF).
Forces the downtime maintenance banner visible (RemoteConfig.SHOW_DOWNTIME_BANNER).
Disables automatic map updating when panning/zooming (RemoteConfig.MAP_AUTO_UPDATE_DISABLED).
Forces sending diagnostic logs with bug reports (RemoteConfig.SEND_DIAGNOSTIC_INFO_LOGS).
Forces linear callout views enabled (RemoteConfig.LINEAR_CALLOUTS_ENABLED).

patches.name: Local Premium
patches.description: Enables local Premium membership status across profile and account screens, removes upgrade promotions, banners, icons, and server-dependent profile statistics, and preserves loaded non-traditional cache details.

patches.name: OpenStreetMap Drop-in Replacement
patches.description: Replaces Google Maps with OpenStreetMap (MapLibre vector engine) and adds in-app OpenStreetMap style switching and custom URL configuration to Map settings.

patches.name: OpenStreetMap Preview Assets
patches.description: Replaces proprietary Google Map type preview webp images with rendered OpenStreetMap style thumbnails in a busy location.

patches.name: OpenStreetMap Resource Strings
patches.description: Updates map type names and descriptions in strings.xml to reflect OpenStreetMap styles.

patches.name: Remove Lists
patches.description: Removes the Lists option from the bottom navigation bar.

patches.name: Remove Shop
patches.description: Removes the Shop Geocaching promotional section and link from the Profile screen.

patches.name: Remove Tracking and Analytics
patches.description: Neutralizes first-party analytics (AnalyticsRepo), Google Analytics / Firebase (Analytics, Crashlytics, Performance, In-App Messaging), Facebook App Events, Iterable marketing telemetry, Usercentrics consent collection, and zeros the Google Play Advertising ID (AAID).

options.description: Neutralizes Firebase Crashlytics diagnostic telemetry and crash reporting.
Neutralizes Facebook App Events SDK logging and activation pings.
Neutralizes Iterable marketing SDK event and push tracking.
Neutralizes Usercentrics consent management and tracking telemetry.

patches.name: Unlock Cache Filter and Sorting Tools
patches.description: Unlocks advanced cache search filters and sorting options without prompting for Geocaching Premium.

patches.name: Unlock Experimental Features
patches.description: Unlocks beta and experimental features in Settings without Geocaching Premium.

options.description: Unlocks all 10% beta features (Activity Feed, Cache Log Translation, Autofill, Confetti, etc.).
Persists and enables the Collaborative Lists, Has Parking, and Trackables Only toggles in Experimental Features.
Keeps experimental feature toggles local without POSTing to or being overwritten by /mobile/v1/user/settings/mobileexperiments.

patches.name: Unlock Templates
patches.description: Unlocks geocache log templates, allowing creating, editing, and applying custom log templates without Geocaching Premium.

patches.name: Remove Tracking and Analytics
patches.description: Neutralizes behavioral tracking (Pendo SDK session recordings, guides, and click tracking), student surveillance telemetry (Pandata pageview recording, time-spent counters, and background upload worker), first-party app analytics (ScreenView processors, offline analytics, token logging), crash reporting (Firebase Crashlytics), and in-app rating prompts.

patches.name: Clean Authentication
patches.description: Shows Google sign-in only and removes the unavailable phone sign-in controls.

options.description: Adds a patched-app caution warning below the Google sign-in message on the login screen.

patches.name: Configure Shortcuts
patches.description: Customizes items displayed in the Your Shortcuts carousel.

options.description: Hides the Refer a Friend shortcut from the Your Shortcuts carousel.
Hides the Giveaway shortcut from the Your Shortcuts carousel.
Hides the Offers shortcut from the Your Shortcuts carousel.
Hides the Rewards shortcut from the Your Shortcuts carousel.
Hides the Sezzle Mobile shortcut from the Your Shortcuts carousel.
Hides the Amazon Deals shortcut from the Your Shortcuts carousel.
Hides the Pay Later Anywhere shortcut from the Your Shortcuts carousel.

patches.name: Enable App Debugging
patches.description: Marks the app debuggable so patch developers can use ADB run-as after reinstalling.

patches.name: Hide Sezzle Mobile
patches.description: Hides Sezzle Mobile offers and account entry points.

patches.name: Patch Consent Screen
patches.description: Requires consent to a patched-app warning before opening Sezzle authentication.

patches.name: Remove Ads and Tracking
patches.description: Removes all ads (AppLovin MAX, Google Mobile Ads, Rokt, Thanks network, Playtime, InBrain Surveys) and disables analytics and tracking SDKs (AppsFlyer, FullStory, Braze, Firebase Analytics, mParticle, Facebook SDK, AppCenter).

patches.name: Remove Promos & Giveaways
patches.description: Blocks in-app deal popups, giveaway screens, Knot card-linking dialogs, and marketing banners across the app.

options.description: Suppresses in-session merchant deal popovers, store offer modals, and webview deal overlays.
Suppresses Knot card auto-sync onboarding dialogs, activation gates, and account linking banners.
Removes promotional merchant cards, empty state marketing, and boost banners from wallet screens.
Neutralizes Playtime campaign listings and rewards promo carousels in Hermes UI.
Hides referral invite banners ("Give and Get"), contact permission prompts, and social share modals.
Hides live trivia giveaway banners and push-to-start game prompts.
Suppresses the pre-permission "Don't Miss Out!" marketing dialog (NotificationPermissionModalV2 / EnableNotificationsModal) and bypasses soft push-opt-in gates.

patches.name: Remove Rewards
patches.description: Removes Rewards navigation while keeping Account's Sezzle Points item and routing the Home shortcut to the same page.

patches.name: Remove Sezzle Subscriptions
patches.description: Removes references to Sezzle Anywhere and Sezzle Premium subscriptions in Account benefits, Wallet, and Orders help.

patches.name: Replace AI Discover with Products
patches.description: Replaces the AI Discover navigation tab with Sezzle's original non-AI Products tab and removes the Sezzle AI callout in search. Includes an option to remove the Products tab completely.

options.description: Removes the Products tab from the navigation bar altogether instead of keeping it as a replacement for Discover.

patches.name: Replace Shop with Home
patches.description: Replaces the Shop bottom navigation tab with Home, a custom screen to replace the overly-commercial Shop screen.

patches.name: Suppress In-App Updates and Rating Prompts
patches.description: Neutralizes Hermes Redux update sagas, UpdateAppModal dialogs, Play Store URL redirects, trustFall tamper detection, and in-app rating prompts.

options.description: Neutralizes Redux force update sagas, version verification selectors, and UpdateAppModal.
Forces trustFall, isJailBroken, hookDetected, and canMockLocation to always return false in Hermes JS.
Suppresses in-app review requests and milestone rating dialogs that redirect to Google Play.

patches.name: Suppress Updates and Integrity Checks
patches.description: Disables Microsoft CodePush OTA updates and neutralizes Dalvik root and tamper detection SDKs (RootBeer and JailMonkey).

options.description: Prevents Microsoft CodePush from downloading remote JavaScript bundles that override local patches.
Bypasses RootBeer and JailMonkey checks in Dalvik bytecode so modified or rooted devices are never flagged.

patches.name: Unlock Custom App Icons
patches.description: Enables custom launcher app icons (Arctic, Peach, Glass, Rainbow, Sand, Classic) without requiring a Sezzle Premium subscription.

patches.name: Unlock Developer Settings
patches.description: Makes the internal Development Settings menu visible to every signed-in account.

patches.name: Unlock Receipt Scanner
patches.description: Makes the receipt scanner available from Development Settings and forces its V2 flow to render. REQUIRES Unlock Developer Settings to be enabled.

patches.name: AMOLED Theme
patches.description: Forces SidelineSwap into a pure-black AMOLED theme with dark system bars, black app surfaces, readable light text and icons, and force dark mode on embedded WebViews.

patches.name: Block Tracking and Telemetry
patches.description: Neutralizes first-party analytics (SidelineSwap backend), behavioral tracking (Amplitude, Firebase Analytics, Facebook App Events, Iterable), diagnostic telemetry (Firebase Crashlytics, Timber logging tree), payment gateway telemetry (Braintree FPTI), and zeros the Google Play Advertising ID (AAID).

patches.name: Change Brand Color
patches.description: Customizes the primary accent brand color across SidelineSwap buttons, navigation highlights, badges, and accents.

options.description: Hex color string (e.g. #1E88E5 for Material Blue, #9C27B0 for Purple, #FF5722 for Orange, #000000 for Monochrome).
Hex color string for status bars and dark accents (defaults to #1565C0).

patches.name: Remove Invite Friends
patches.description: Removes the Invite Friends option from the Account screen and eliminates the non-functional orange dot notification badge from the Account navigation icon.

patches.name: Add Custom Chip Store
patches.description: Replaces the unavailable store with a dialog to view and set your exact chip balance.

patches.name: Remove Ads
patches.description: Removes banner, interstitial, and rewarded advertising and removes ad-based chip offers.

patches.name: Remove Internet Permissions
patches.description: Removes Internet permissions from AndroidManifest.xml to prevent network access.

options.description: Removes Help Center buttons whose network-only content is unavailable without Internet access.

patches.name: Remove Notifications
patches.description: Removes notification permissions from AndroidManifest.xml to eliminate push notifications entirely.

patches.name: Remove Tracking and Analytics
patches.description: Neutralizes active advertising telemetry, analytics, attribution, and crash reporting.

patches.name: Skip to Next Level
patches.description: Allows tapping the next level indicator on the top bar to show a confirmation dialog and skip to the next level. REQUIRES Add Custom Chip Store to be enabled.
